Title: Passage 2: [Excerpt from] “The Perfect Hiding Spot”
Author: by Clare Mishica
Content: Rabbit was going to the park to play games with Mouse when he spied something shiny by his steps. It was a big silver coin. “I'm so lucky!” said Rabbit as he picked up the treasure. Where could he hide it?
His garden was the perfect place.

In a flash, Rabbit dug a hole next to his tomato plant. Clumps of earth flew up like a fountain. Rabbit carefully placed the coin in the hole and covered it again. He made an `text(X)` with `text(two)` sticks so he could find the spot.
Pleased with his work, Rabbit brushed off his paws. Then he glanced down at his clothes. They were covered in dirt, too.
Rabbit went inside to wash up. Splish! Splish! Splash! He scrubbed his clothes and washed his face.
All at `text(once)`, Rabbit's forehead wrinkled with worry. What if Mole dug a tunnel under his garden? Mole might find the coin and take it. Rabbit had to hide his treasure inside his house.
Rabbit dashed outside to rescue his coin. Clumps of dirt stuck to his wet feet, but Rabbit didn't notice. He hurried back inside and put the coin in his cookie jar.

But as he stared at the jar, Rabbit's forehead wrinkled again. What if Coyote peeked into the jar? Sometimes, while Coyote was visiting, he sneaked a cookie. Rabbit's silver coin was not safe there. He had to find a better place.

Rabbit searched and searched for the perfect hiding spot. He tried tucking the coin inside his umbrella. He tried putting it under his pillow. No matter where Rabbit hid the coin, it didn't seem safe.

With a big sigh, Rabbit plopped down in a chair at his kitchen table. His floor was a mess of muddy trails, and Mouse was at the park without him. Rabbit stared at the coin sitting on his table. Then an idea popped into his head. He knew the perfect place for the treasure.
Rabbit grabbed his coin and skipped down the path to the park. He found Mouse on a swing by the pond. “Hi, Mouse!” Rabbit called. “Sorry I'm late.”
Mouse ran over to join Rabbit, who was standing near a square machine.
Clink! Rabbit put his coin into a slot in the machine. Click! He pushed a button. Plunk! A fat bag fell down. It was full of peanuts.
“It's our lucky day,” Rabbit told Mouse. Then Rabbit opened the bag and shared the snack with his friend.
